title: Atrium Livings | Architectural & Interior Design Magazine
tagline: The Definitive Journal of Modern Architecture, Interior Spaces & Artful Living
description: Atrium Livings is an independent architectural and interior design journal curating the finest modern kitchens, spa-like bathrooms, Japandi living spaces, bespoke furniture, and sustainable renovation guides.

categories.name: Kitchen
categories.title: Kitchen Architecture, Cabinetry & Culinary Design
categories.description: Explore high-end kitchen layouts, bespoke fluted cabinetry, marble slab islands, and luxury smart culinary spaces designed for seamless entertaining.

categories.name: Bathroom
categories.title: Bathroom Sanctuaries, Tile Architecture & Spa Fixtures
categories.description: From space-efficient powder rooms to travertine wet rooms, discover bathroom floor tile patterns, floating stone vanities, and tactile brassware.

categories.name: Living Room
categories.title: Living Rooms: Organic Modern & Warm Minimalist Lounges
categories.description: Curate cohesive living room seating zones, sculptural statement fireplaces, layered 2700K ambient lighting, and bespoke media joinery.

categories.name: Bedroom
categories.title: Primary Bedroom Suites, Acoustic Comfort & Calming Palettes
categories.description: Transform restful quarters with upholstered acoustic headboards, pure Belgian linen bedding, recessed mood lighting, and serene plaster finishes.

categories.name: Home Decor
categories.title: Home Decor, Ceramic Vessels & Textile Styling
categories.description: The art of the final layer: artisanal stone accessories, handmade stoneware, gallery wall compositions, and textural woolen throws.

categories.name: Furniture
categories.title: Modern Furniture Classics, Joinery & Sustainable Woodcraft
categories.description: In-depth analyses of iconic mid-century silhouettes, curved bouclé sofas, solid walnut dining tables, and heirloom custom joinery.

categories.name: Lighting
categories.title: Architectural Lighting: Pendants, Sconces & Concealed LEDs
categories.description: Mastering the 3 layers of illumination: ambient, task, and accent lighting with dim-to-warm 2700K illumination and alabaster fixtures.

categories.name: Renovation
categories.title: Renovation Chronicles: Structural Overhauls & Cost Guides
categories.description: Authoritative architectural guidelines for load-bearing modifications, permit workflows, realistic cost breakdowns, and general contractor collaboration.

categories.name: DIY
categories.title: Artisanal DIY: Fluting, Plaster Finishes & Custom Joinery
categories.description: Step-by-step masterclasses in limewash application, bespoke slatted acoustic panel fabrication, and custom architectural mouldings.

categories.name: Garden & Outdoor
categories.title: Courtyards, Pergolas & Architectural Landscape Architecture
categories.description: Blur the boundaries between indoors and nature with thermal limestone terraces, cantilevered steel pergolas, and native botanical gardens.

categories.name: Small Spaces
categories.title: Small Space Architecture: Pocket Doors, Mirrors & Built-ins
categories.description: Micro-luxury spatial planning: pocket joinery, concealed beds, visual sightline elongation, and multi-functional architectural furniture.

categories.name: Design Trends
categories.title: Global Design Forecasts, Biophilia & Tactile Textures
categories.description: Forecast reports evaluating quiet luxury, fluted surfaces, warm earth minerals, retro chromes, and sustainable biophilic architecture.

authors.name: Elena Vance, AIA
authors.bio: Elena Vance is a licensed architectural designer (AIA) with over 16 years of experience in residential restoration and passive home design across San Francisco and Milan. Her work has been showcased at the Venice Architecture Biennale.
authors.credentials: M.Arch Harvard GSD, AIA, LEED AP BD+C

authors.name: Marcus Reid
authors.bio: Marcus specializes in heritage joinery, sustainable timber curation, and precision residential renovation budgeting. With a background in structural engineering and architectural preservation, he dissects contractor specifications with rigorous technical clarity.
authors.credentials: B.Eng Structural Design, Member of Association for Preservation Technology

authors.name: Charlotte Dupuis
authors.bio: Based between Paris and New York, Charlotte curates decorative objects, vintage mid-century furniture acquisitions, and contemporary ceramic installations. She regularly consults for premier international boutique hotels.
authors.credentials: B.A. Art History Sorbonne Paris IV, Contributing Critic at Milan Furniture Fair
